units.rawText: Ah, is this about what they mentioned earlier; repairing the memory fragment?

units.rawText: The first meeting between Commander and me was quite an ordinary one. I was just wandering near the Oasis, then accidentally found a group of Dolls settling in, and I just moved in with them.

units.rawText: You know how I work, Commander. I avoid contact with others at the Oasis so I don't unsettle them. Only the maid, Centaureissi, and you keep in touch with me.

units.rawText: But the Rise we see now is different from the one we first met, isn't it?

units.rawText: ...Hehe, like you said, thanks to Commander's support, I've found and done the work I wish to do.

units.rawText: Whether it was helping Jiangyu with filming or talking with Nora, those experiences taught an amateur like me so much. At the same time, they've made me start imagining a future in the film industry once we return to the real world.

units.rawText: I have no doubt you'll shine, Rise.

units.rawText: With the Commander's blessing, I feel one step closer to achieving my dream. I'll start by documenting this war for Magrasea's survival... as my first step towards a new future.
